KIDDO.SCHOOL

A little school of possibility.

Make · Learn · Discover.

Their first school starts with you

Kiddo.school is a growing digital school for curious children and the adults learning alongside them. The journey begins at birth with short, parent-led baby and toddler classes, and continues through hands-on classrooms — art, science, nature, maths, stories and engineering — as children grow. Ten classes from birth to age two are ready today, with more on the drawing table.

More curiosity, less perfection

A crooked collage, a bridge that bends or a seed that has not sprouted can all begin a useful conversation. The aim is to notice, try, question and make something your own.

From the Principal’s Office

Welcome to Kiddo.school. This school is a little different: you are the teacher, and we are the helper. Every class is short enough to fit real life — five playful minutes together can be enough, and you can continue the lesson naturally during your day.

Two promises from the school office: age ranges here are guides, never tests or developmental deadlines, and nothing on Kiddo School is a score. Children learn at their own pace, and noticing one red thing together already counts as a class.

Simple and open to explore

The school is free to browse, with no account required. Every class and activity includes parent guidance, age adaptations and clear steps. The collection includes original illustrations, printable image sheets and interactive on-screen classes.
